messages.subject: geom_hline aes offset?
parts:
I've removed panel.grid's to create a custom gridline.

I'm trying to create new horizontal gridlines using geom_hline with the following command: -

    geom_hline(aes(yintercept=gene), size=0.05, colour="grey75")+

This works fine, however I would like the line to hit the top/bottom of the row instead of running through the middle of it  (see attached picture).  



I can see that this code produces a similar result: -

    geom_hline(aes(yintercept=seq(0.5,2.5,by=1)), size=0.05, colour="grey75")+

However this doesn't help when the number of rows varies (e.g. facet_grid).

Is there any way to apply an offset to geom_hline?  Conceptually something like this (though 'gene' is a name so this obviously doesn't work):

    geom_hline(aes(yintercept=gene-0.5), size=0.05, colour="grey75")

Thanks

On Sun, Nov 6, 2011 at 3:55 PM, CK <combiz...@gmail.com> wrote:
>
> I've removed panel.grid's to create a custom gridline.
> I'm trying to create new horizontal gridlines using geom_hline with the following command: -
>     geom_hline(aes(yintercept=gene), size=0.05, colour="grey75")+
> This works fine, however I would like the line to hit the top/bottom of the row instead of running through the middle of it  (see attached picture).
>
>

> I can see that this code produces a similar result: -
>     geom_hline(aes(yintercept=seq(0.5,2.5,by=1)), size=0.05, colour="grey75")+
> However this doesn't help when the number of rows varies (e.g. facet_grid).

It's undocumented, but you can do:

geom_hline(aes(yintercept=as.numeric(gene)), size=0.05, colour="grey75")
geom_hline(aes(yintercept=as.numeric(gene) + 0.5), size=0.05, colour="grey75")

etc
